$comment: GATING. Binds every discovery document to the generation manifest that produced it, and fixes where selection chronology lives. Discovery-input/evidence plumbing only.

does_not_touch: the BundleEntry contract or any ruling on it

identity_protocol.role: AUTHORITY for expected params hashes and identity-field consistency. Not a peer of the manifest or the document.

schema_version_decision.verdict: MAJOR bump of the discovery-document schema.
schema_version_decision.reasoning: A new REQUIRED top-level object invalidates every previously valid document, and under the strict codec already in force (additionalProperties: false) an older reader also rejects the new field. Both directions break, so this is not additive.
schema_version_decision.cost_now_versus_later: Zero legacy corpus exists -- no discovery document has been promoted yet. The bump therefore needs no back-compatibility shim and no dual-read path. That will not be true after the first promotion, which is the argument for doing it in this change rather than deferring it.
schema_version_decision.version_number: Engineer 3 applies the MAJOR bump to the current schema version. This ruling fixes the CLASS of bump, not the numeral -- I have not read the current schema and will not assert its version.

source_path.semantics: Repository-relative path of the exact immutable generation_manifest.json consumed by promotion.

source_sha256.semantics: RECOMPUTED by promotion from the manifest bytes. Never copied from anywhere.

computed_at_commit.semantics: Full git commit containing those exact manifest bytes. Verified by reading the blob at that commit, not by trusting the field.

manifest_granularity.verdict: ONE MANIFEST PER (run_id, configuration, concept_id, pairing_id, direction). NOT one covering both directions.
manifest_granularity.direction_field: SCALAR. Never an array, never nested.
reasoning: Amplify and Suppress are already separated at every level by standing ruling: different prompt sets (neutral vs eliciting), different dose grids (ascending CLAMP vs descending CLAMP plus ABLATE), different stopping rules, separate selection records. A shared manifest would be the single place they recombine.

DECISIVE: Amplify-only publication is permitted and expected. A concept passing G-D but failing G-E would leave a combined manifest containing a direction that produced no promotable result, forcing promotion to PARTIALLY accept an attestation. Partial acceptance of an attestation is the exact failure mode this protocol chain exists to remove.
Item 9 of the ruling -- a manifest covering another direction blocks promotion -- is mechanically checkable against a scalar and awkward against an array.
No extra cost: concept-complete generation ordering means both directions finish in the same pass, so the two manifests are written at the same moment.
manifest_granularity.co_allocation_is_still_provable: Both per-direction manifests carry the SAME run_id and source_commit. Co-allocation is proven by shared identity rather than by merging the records, so separating them loses nothing.

manifest_required_bindings.source_commit: full git commit of the code that generated
manifest_required_bindings.concept_id: string, from the frozen prompt artifact
manifest_required_bindings.params_measured_sha256: sha256:<64 hex>, MEASURED from the loaded file, not copied from the identity protocol

item.dose: the dose identifier; for SUPPRESS, ABLATE is a legal value
item.sha256: sha256:<64 hex>, full digest of the output file
item.seed: integer, the generation seed for this file

identity_equality_checks.$comment: Exhaustive. Promotion fails on any mismatch.

three_way_including_the_identity_protoco.check: manifest.params_measured_sha256 == document's recorded value == identity v1.3.0 params_expected_sha256 for that configuration
three_way_including_the_identity_protoco.why_three_way: A two-way check between manifest and document passes when both were copied from each other and both are wrong. The identity protocol is the AUTHORITY; manifest and document must each agree WITH IT, not merely with one another. Same principle as forbidding the document to attest by copying the manifest's self-declared digest.

internal_consistency_rechecked_not_assum: scientific_sae_id is prefixed by the hook-family directory implied by release: resid_post_all/ for -res-all, resid_post/ for -res.
loader_sae_id appears only alongside release, never alone.
release, layer and tier form a combination the identity protocol records as available.
value_checks: completeness == COMPLETE. PARTIAL and NOT_ATTEMPTED block promotion.
every files[].sha256 recomputed from the file on disk; any mismatch blocks promotion.

SEED DISJOINTNESS RE-VERIFIED FROM THE MANIFEST: the set of seeds where purpose == SWEEP and the set where purpose == CONFIRMATION must not intersect at the same (dose, prompt). The generation job asserts this; promotion must verify it independently, because a self-reported assertion is not evidence.
exactly three files per (dose set) carry selection_status SELECTED per dose, and the two unselected doses' files carry UNUSED_FOR_SELECTION_OR_CLAIM.

selection_commit.semantics: full git commit containing those exact selection-record bytes

THREE_LINK_CHAIN.$comment: THE ADDITION. The recommendation specifies only link 2, which proves selection preceded judging but leaves open whether generation preceded selection -- the more consequential of the two.
THREE_LINK_CHAIN.link_1: generation_manifest.computed_at_commit is a STRICT ANCESTOR of causal_validation.selection_record.selection_commit
THREE_LINK_CHAIN.link_1_why: Without it, the manifest could be committed AFTER doses were chosen, meaning the generation files could have been produced or altered once the selection was known. Link 2 alone cannot detect that.
THREE_LINK_CHAIN.link_2: selection_commit is a STRICT ANCESTOR of confirmation_judging_commit
THREE_LINK_CHAIN.link_3: prompt_set_record's commit is a STRICT ANCESTOR of causal_validation_record's commit
THREE_LINK_CHAIN.link_3_status: PRE-EXISTING, restated here so the full chain reads in one place.
THREE_LINK_CHAIN.full_chain: prompt sets frozen -> generation manifest committed -> selection committed -> confirmation judged
THREE_LINK_CHAIN.strictness: STRICT ancestry throughout. Equal commits are a FAILURE: if two records land in the same commit, nothing about their order is established.
THREE_LINK_CHAIN.existence: Every referenced commit must exist and be reachable. An unreachable or dangling commit blocks promotion.

prohibited_verification_shortcuts: Path-only: confirming a file exists at source_path is not verification.
Self-hash-only: reading the manifest's own self-declared digest is circular.
Copied-digest: the document quoting the manifest's declared digest instead of promotion recomputing it from bytes.
Trusting computed_at_commit without reading the blob at that commit.
Trusting the generation job's own seed-disjointness assertion instead of re-deriving it from the recorded seeds.
Treating dose checking as an optional side report. IT IS PART OF PROMOTION.
promotion_blocking_conditions: generation_manifest object absent from the discovery document.
manifest missing, unreadable, malformed, or not committed.
computed_at_commit does not contain those exact manifest bytes.
any two-way identity mismatch between manifest and document.
params sha256 disagreeing with identity v1.3.0 on any of the three sides.
manifest covering another concept_id, pairing_id, configuration, run_id or direction.
sweep and confirmation seeds intersecting at the same cell.
any chronology link failing, including equal commits where strict ancestry is required.
protocol_path or protocol_sha256 not matching the frozen one-allocation protocol exactly.

preserved_unchanged.feature_certificate: SEPARATE and preserved. Not folded into the four, not replaced.

relationship_to_existing_evidence.generation_manifest_role: Supports DOSE VERIFICATION. It is a provenance binding for the generation step, consumed by PROMOTION.
generation_manifest_is_not: a substitute for any of the four binding evidence records
an ATTESTED requirement -- ATTESTED still needs its four content-addressed evidence_refs
relationship_to_existing_evidence.two_gates_two_inputs: The four evidence_refs plus feature_certificate satisfy ATTESTED, which is a claim about scientific results. The generation manifest satisfies promotion, which is a claim about which bytes produced them. Different gates, different inputs, same hash-recomputation discipline. Neither absorbs the other.
